name: Gods Love For Us
overview: God's love for us is revealed as compassionate, gracious, and enduring, characterized by mercy and truth as shown in Psalms 86:15. This love is everlasting and draws us with lovingkindness, as Jeremiah 31:3 affirms, and it rejoices over us with joy and singing according to Zephaniah 3:17. The greatest demonstration of this love is God giving His only begotten Son for the world, so that believers may have eternal life (John 3:16), and Christ's sacrificial death for sinners confirms God's commendation of His love toward us (Romans 5:8). Jesus teaches that no greater love exists than laying down one’s life for friends (John 15:13), underscoring the self-giving nature of divine love.
